transcript.text: Here are my formal commissioning findings for the record: My commissioning trial found that loop conductivity reaches 1,200 microsiemens per centimeter after 40 cycles, while Line 4's rinse specification allows no more than 900. The validated operating plan is to purge exactly 300 liters every 30 cycles to stay within specification. The skid vendor confirmed that pump-seal replacement and recommissioning require exactly 6 hours. My trial worksheet is still awaiting engineering signoff, which I'm noting as a pending engineering item.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Here is my formal environmental compliance finding for the record: My permit review, confirmed with the regulator yesterday, requires that every recovery-loop purge be neutralized to a pH from exactly 6.5 through 8.5, sampled before discharge, and entered in the wastewater log. I have not yet attached the regulator's note to the utility change record. I am formally recording this as a required pre-start commitment: the neutralization, pH sampling, and wastewater log entry procedures must be in place and the regulator's note must be attached to the utility change record before the system proceeds into production service.
